title: COVID survival/hazard or multinomial recovery model

source.request:
Impact covid:
Survival analysis??

Did COVID change the composition of Indonesian manufacturing? Which firms survived and recovered?
source.strategy:
Survival analysis

Survival/hazard model menggunakan pre-COVID characteristics. Alternative: multinomial outcomes: exit, temporary disappearance, survive-shrink, survive-grow.
source.notes: Melihat firms yg bertahan, mati dan hidup selama shock covid

question: Which factories remained observable, closed, or recovered during COVID?
rationale: Keep actual closure distinct from survey disappearance, temporary gaps and movement outside the survey frame.
scope: Full exact Word row, interpreted through repository minimum checks and current owner full-plan ning/full-row acceptance gates. All analysis below is planned, not executed.
unit_of_analysis: Fixed verified 2019 incumbent cohort with annual states 2020–2022; plant-year risk sets for confirmed closure.

target_estimands.name: Primary requested target
target_estimands.formula: h_it = Pr(closure_it=1 | alive_i,t-1=1, X_i,pre); Pr(state_i,2022=s | X_i,pre) = exp(X beta_s)/sum_r exp(X beta_r)

symbols.i: a verified establishment, never a row-number or artificial linkage
symbols.V: value added deflated with a certified appropriate price index; any single-output-deflator approximation is named
symbols.Y: gross output deflated with its certified output-price index
symbols.E: scope-defined verified physical energy in GJ; incomplete observed subtotals are separately named
symbols.C: scope-defined verified CO2 in metric tonnes; not automatically all greenhouse gases
symbols.L: workers under an annually verified employment definition
symbols.X: predetermined measured covariates declared for the particular design
symbols.g: verified treatment-entry cohort in calendar years
symbols.S: a verified trade, ownership, industry, or survival state; unknown is retained as unknown
symbols.h_it: conditional probability of verified closure during year t
symbols.state_i,2022: mutually exclusive endpoint trajectory state of the 2019 incumbent cohort
symbols.beta_s: multinomial logit coefficients for states; interpret predicted probabilities
symbols.alive_i,t-1: verified at-risk state at the previous interval start

target_estimands.interpretation: Hazard is a conditional closure risk only if closure is verified. Multinomial probabilities describe mutually exclusive 2022 trajectories of the 2019 cohort.
target_estimands.limits: Observed absence is not business death. A model of post 2019 outcomes does not identify the causal effect of COVID. Right censoring and pre-existing frame changes matter.

decisions.question: Which factories and outcomes define the target?
decisions.selected_rule: Use seven mutually exclusive 2022 endpoint states for every verified 2019 incumbent: verified closure by 2022; observed in 2022 after an earlier observation gap; continuously observed with output shrink below −5%; continuously observed with output change from −5% through +5%; continuously observed with output growth above +5%; continuously observed but recovery output not measurable; absent in 2022 with no verified closure. Apply closure precedence only when evidence is coherent with later records; contradictions stop classification. Repeat the three recovery thresholds at 0% and 10% as sensitivities. Output-missing factories remain in the cohort.

Comparison-only validators may read older data but may not feed construction or estimates. External reference and metadata inputs retain explicit non-company roles.
